name: data-list
title: Data list
description: The facts about one thing, as terms and values.
use: One thing described by many properties: a deployment's region, commit and duration; an order's address and total. Write it as a dl with a div around each dt and dd.

instead.when: Many things are compared by the same properties, so the terms would repeat for every row
Each row is a thing of its own, with media, a name and a control
It is one headline figure and how it moved

classes.name: data-list
classes.description: The list, on a dl: a two-column grid and a size container; under 20rem each term moves above its value

classes.name: data-list-item
classes.description: A row, on a div around one term and its value; a hairline parts it from the next

classes.name: data-list-term
classes.description: The term, on a dt, in muted ink

classes.name: data-list-value
classes.description: The value, on a dd, in strong ink and tabular figures; long values wrap anywhere
